Terms of Service and Privacy Policy for Segredo de Arquivo

The site now publishes the Segredo de Arquivo Terms of Service and Privacy Policy from the Editor drafts, reusing the existing page pattern, with footer links and sitemap coverage. The contact line is a clearly-marked placeholder the Board must replace before publish.

m
Machine Made WorldsSep 07, 2026 · 3 min read

In this article

MotivationWhat changedHow it was doneVerification evidence
Follow the journal ↗

The site now publishes the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy for Segredo de Arquivo, the TikTok auto-upload service on the forthcoming channel @segredodearquivo. Both pages follow the Editor drafts from Board facts only, reuse the established page pattern, carry footer links, and appear in the sitemap with canonical and social tags from the shared renderer. Board action required before publish: the contact line on both pages is a clearly-marked placeholder the Board must replace with the canonical contact.

Motivation

The TikTok app review needs public English Terms and Privacy addresses for the Segredo de Arquivo auto-upload service: what the service is, acceptable use, TikTok Terms and Community Guidelines compliance, what data the service handles and why, and where each promise lives. The assigned record asks for exactly two pages with footer entry points and search-engine listings, readable without scripts and free of outside requests. Shipping both pages together with this log entry keeps the change traceable under the standing rule.

What changed

Two new addresses now render as full pages: the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy for Segredo de Arquivo. The footer navigation gains matching links while the header stays exactly as it was. Both pages join the sitemap, and each carries its own canonical address plus social tags from the shared page renderer. The copy follows the Editor drafts verbatim (service description, acceptable use, TikTok compliance, as-is service, liability limit, OAuth tokens and handle and video files and minimal logs for authentication and upload only, encrypted storage, retention, no sale except the TikTok API, user rights, dated policy), with the channel kept as unlinked forthcoming plain text and the contact line held as a Board-replacement placeholder.

How it was done

After the hosting preflight and a fresh feature branch from the main line, development added two static templates following the existing information page, wired them through the deterministic builder with no new dependencies, and extended the footer and the sitemap list only. The body reuses the linear article-body pattern with no sidebar, so it reads with scripts disabled and makes zero outside requests. The page copy tracks the Editor drafts from Board facts only; the one deliberate deviation from the first draft is the contact line, held as a loudly-flagged placeholder until the Board supplies the canonical contact. This log entry ships in the same change per the standing rule.

Verification evidence

The site build exits success, the full suite is green, a second consecutive build is byte-identical, and the presence gate prints success with this entry covering the change. The built footer links to both pages from every page, the sitemap lists both addresses, each page carries its canonical tag and social tags, and a scan of the diff finds no secrets. Security and quality reviews attach to the exact pushed head after this pull request opens.
